evidence: The film crystalline structure was examined by a Rigaku D/MAX 3.V X-ray diffractometer... The surface morphology was characterized by a Philips XL-40FEG scanning electron microscope... The photocatalytic activity of as-deposited films was evaluated by measuring the degradation of methylene blue... Variations in the transmittance of MB solutions were monitored by a UV/visible spectrometer... The thickness of the TiO2 film was determined by a Fivelab-MARY-102 ellipsometer.
